lines.text: Endmin? I came to see if I could help, but ... I can make some time for you.
I actually thought you'd be busy... Is there anything I can do for you?
Nothing. I just came to see you.
Okay. I'll be around to help.
Feel free to look around as long as you like.
I'd like to visit your "home" again.
You mean that street at the bottom of the gorge...?
Sure. I've been thinking of going back for a look too.

options: I'd like to visit your "home" again.

r: I'd like to visit your "home" again.
